summary: Never exited - held the full 39-frame window. The trade was a strongly working short: repeated giveback episodes (up to 65-69% of a leg's amplitude) always resolved back to new favorable highs, climbing from +0 to a peak near +74pts with ER10 climbing above 0.5-0.7 during the strongest legs. Individual against-fires (KMDR/HA/PROPP) never coincided with a genuine trend break - price kept making higher favorable extremes after each pullback. Next time I'd watch for a giveback that fails to make a new high within a few minutes (i.e., leg amplitude stalling while giveback% stays elevated) combined with ER10 staying pinned near zero, as the actual reversal signature rather than reacting to single against-fires or single-frame giveback spikes.
